user.title: Set up an AI coach
user.description: The AI Task integration analyses the chosen entities on a schedule and returns a score, a summary, up to five tips and how reliable the data are. The prompt can be customised later in the options.

data_description.name: Used for the device and in the entity IDs: the name Energy gives sensor.ai_coach_energy_score and so on.
data_description.topic: What the AI should evaluate, in a few words, for example "energy use of the home".
data_description.entities: Name, area, value and unit of these entities are sent to the AI.
data_description.label: Also every entity with this label, and the sensors of every device with it.
data_description.instructions: Goals, context and references the AI should use. Added to the standard prompt.
data_description.ai_task_entity: Empty: the first AI Task entity found.
data_description.update_interval: 0 = no periodic analysis. With a time window, runs only inside it.
data_description.active_from: Start of the time window for the periodic analysis (optional).
data_description.active_until: End of the time window for the periodic analysis (optional).
data_description.run_at: A fixed daily analysis, in addition to the periodic one (optional).

error.no_data: Choose at least one entity or a label (or write a prompt template).
error.window_incomplete: Set both ends of the time window, or neither.

init.title: AI coach options
init.description: Change what is analysed, when and how. The prompt template is for advanced users: leave it empty to use the standard prompt.

data_description.topic: What the AI should evaluate, in a few words, for example "energy use of the home".
data_description.entities: Name, area, value and unit of these entities are sent to the AI.
data_description.label: Also every entity with this label, and the sensors of every device with it.
data_description.instructions: Goals, context and references the AI should use. Added to the standard prompt.
data_description.ai_task_entity: Empty: the first AI Task entity found.
data_description.update_interval: 0 = no periodic analysis. With a time window, runs only inside it.
data_description.active_from: Start of the time window for the periodic analysis (optional).
data_description.active_until: End of the time window for the periodic analysis (optional).

data_description.prompt_template: Replaces the standard prompt. Jinja template rendered at every analysis, with the variables coach_data (the entity values), topic, language and instructions. The answer is always summary, score, tips and confidence.

error.no_data: Choose at least one entity or a label (or write a prompt template).
error.window_incomplete: Set both ends of the time window, or neither.

entry_not_found.message: No AI Coach entry with ID {entry_id}.

entry_not_loaded.message: The AI coach {name} is not loaded.

run_analysis.name: Run analysis
run_analysis.description: Runs the AI analysis of a coach now and returns the result.

set_result.name: Set result
set_result.description: Writes the result of a coach by hand, for example to carry over the last analysis from helpers.

tips.name: Tips
tips.description: Up to five tips, each in the form "Theme: text".
